A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MOONSHOT research work, with complete main text and Appendices A.1–A.12. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support a reliable comparison of all 35 pages.

before.justification: v1 reports original pruning experiments on Llama language models, DeiT vision transformers, and ResNet-50, including benchmark results, ablations, and runtime measurements in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original pruning experiments, benchmark results, ablations, and runtime measurements reported in v1.

M1.justification: The combined reconstruction/Fisher objective, block-diagonal approximations, inverse-Hessian procedure, and pruning adaptations are unchanged in Section 2 and Appendices A.2–A.4.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ImageNet-1k, C4, WikiText2, PTB, and seven downstream classification benchmarks. Model coverage, including the Llama Instruct experiments in Appendix A.9, and pruning scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain CAP, OBC, SparseGPT, Wanda, and OSSCAR, including the same OWL and AlphaPruning combinations. No comparator is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: Calibration sample counts, evaluation metrics, sparsity settings, model configurations, lambda selection, and Hessian-recomputation protocols are unchanged throughout Section 3 and the appendices.

E4.justification: Section 4 and Appendices A.7–A.8 and A.10–A.11 retain the same analyses of lambda, sparsity, Hessian recomputation, and extending MOONSHOT to projection layers.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same three-seed averaging and standard errors. Run information, uncertainty reporting, and statements about statistical significance are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–19 and the result figures retain identical scores, runtime measurements, uncertainty values, and trends. The comprehensive results in Appendix A.12 are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, quadratic reformulation, Woodbury derivation, and OSSCAR backsolve equations in Section 2 and Appendices A.3–A.4 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about complementary pruning objectives, the MOONSHOT framework, scalability, and empirical benefits.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the complementary objectives, performance gains, Hessian recomputation, and computational tradeoffs are identical. No applicability boundary or limitation is added or revised.

D1.justification: Hardware, implementation details, hyperparameters, calibration procedures, and runtime information remain unchanged in Section 3 and the appendices. No technical or resource-access information is added.

R1.justification: The citations, bibliography, Appendix A.1 related-work discussion, and positioning relative to earlier pruning methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: The acknowledgment on page 14 adds ONR grant N000142512504 and reorders the funders. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; the remaining prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–6, Tables 1–19, and the algorithm displays retain their content, formatting, captions, and placement. The acknowledgment rewraps within the same space without altering the page structure.

improvement.justification: v2 makes funding attribution slightly more specific by adding the ONR grant identifier. The scientific content, evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and appendices are unchanged, so this administrative refinement produces no meaningful overall quality difference.
